newsitem.title: USA: Orange & Rockland making natgas changes.
newsitem.headline: Orange & Rockland making natgas changes.

text.p: Orange and Rockland Utilities Inc said its natural gas marketing subsidiary is making an effort to secure higher margin customers.

While the unit continued to underperform in 1996 and experienced a net loss for the year, a strategic initiative begun in the third quarter of 1996 is aimed at securing lower volume, higher margin customers, and will be fully implemented during 1997, the utility said.
It said 1997 first quarter results will be hurt by the recent arbitration decision regarding the 1993 dismissal of the company's former chairman.
O&R said its 1996 earnings were unaffected by the decision due to amounts previously provided.
